items.fullText: 모빌리티 현대차, 美 뉴욕서 '디 올 뉴 투싼' 공개…“역대 투싼 중 최고” 발행일 : 2026-10-02 10:07 전자신문을 선호 매체로 추가 공유하기 페이스북 X(트위터) X(트위터) --> 메일 URL 복사 글자크기 설정 가 작게 가 보통 가 크게 현대차 디 올 뉴 투싼. 현대자동차가 미국 뉴욕에서 신형 투싼을 세계 최초로 공개하고 글로벌 준중형 스포츠유틸리티차(SUV) 시장 공략에 본격 나섰다. 현대차는 1일(현지시간) 뉴욕에서 '디 올 뉴 투싼 월드 프리미어'를 열고 글로벌 미디어와 인플루언서를 대상으로 '신형 투싼'을 공개했다고 밝혔다. 행사는 뉴욕 스카이라인을 배경으로 런웨이 형태의 무대를 구성해 신형 투싼이 강조하는 '대담함(Boldness)'을 시각적으로 구현했다. 현대차는 차량 공개와 전시 콘텐츠를 통해 투싼의 디자인과 상품성, 브랜드 방향성을 소개했다. 호세 무뇨스 현대차 대표이사(사장)는 “이번에 소개하는 투싼은 현대차가 지금까지 만든 역대 모든 투싼 중 최고”라며 “대담한 디자인과 넓은 실내 공간, 스마트한 인포테인먼트와 효율적인 하이브리드 기술을 결합해 시장의 새로운 기준을 제시할 것”이라고 말했다. 현대차 디 올 뉴 투싼. 이어 “투싼을 시작으로 2030년까지 세계적으로 100개 이상의 신차와 페이스리프트 모델을 출시할 예정이며 북미 지역에서만 58개의 신차를 선보일 것”이라고 밝혔다. 현대차는 계획한 2030년 신차와 부분변경(페이스리프트) 모델은 북미 58개로 한국 49개, 유럽 41개, 인도 26개, 중국 22개보다 많다. 글로벌 시장에서 북미를 최우선에 두겠다는 구상으로 투싼은 핵심 차종으로 꼽힌다. 신형 투싼은 현대차의 디자인 철학 '아트 오브 스틸(Art of Steel)'을 바탕으로 강철의 견고함을 현대적으로 재해석했다. 차체는 전장 4700㎜, 전폭 1905㎜로 기존 모델보다 커졌으며 H-엣지 라이팅과 3D 플로팅 조각 디자인을 적용한 프리즘 리어 램프를 적용했다. 차세대 하이브리드 시스템과 신규 인포테인먼트 시스템도 탑재했다. 투싼에는 현대차 SUV 최초로 안드로이드 오토모티브 운영체제(AAOS) 기반 '플레오스 커넥트'가 적용된다. 대형언어모델(LLM) 기반 인공지능(AI) 에이전트 '글레오 AI'가 자연어를 활용한 차량 제어와 정보 검색을 지원하며 플레오스 앱마켓을 통한 서드파티 서비스도 제공한다. 현대차 디 올 뉴 투싼. 하이브리드 모델에는 정차 상태에서 시동을 켜지 않고 공조와 인포테인먼트 등을 사용할 수 있는 '스테이 모드'도 적용했다. 북미 시장에서 가솔린과 하이브리드 파워트레인을 운용한다. 북미 전용 모델로 오프로드 성능을 강화한 XRT 프로(PRO) 모델을 추가로 선보일 계획이다. 국내에서는 1.6 터보 가솔린과 1.6 터보 하이브리드 두 가지 파워트레인으로 출시된다. 하이브리드 모델은 현대차그룹의 차세대 하이브리드 시스템을 탑재해 시스템 최고출력 245마력(PS), 복합연비 17.4㎞/ℓ를 확보했다. 현대차는 12일 프랑스 파리에서 열리는 파리 모터쇼에서 유럽 시장에 맞춘 투싼 전용 모델을 추가 공개할 예정이다. 국내에서는 지난달 18일 경기 파주 CJ ENM 스튜디오 센터에서 신형 투싼을 먼저 공개한 바 있다. 현대차는 10월 중 가격을 공개하고 국내 시장에서 본격적인 판매에 돌입할 예정이다. 김지웅 기자 jw0316@etnews.com 디올 뉴 투싼 투싼 하이브리드 SUV

items.t: U.S. pressures European allies to release diesel reserves as Trump considers export ban
items.d: The Trump administration asked European allies to release diesel from their emergency stockpiles to increase global supplies and tamp down on soaring prices.
items.fullText: Iran war U.S. pressures European allies to release diesel reserves as Trump considers export ban The average price of U.S. diesel fuel has soared by 70% since late February. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Energy Secretary Chris Wright said Wednesday that Europe would supply diesel from its emergency reserves. But the E.U. says talks are ongoing. Anna Moneymaker / Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 1, 2026, 3:41 PM EDT / Updated Oct. 1, 2026, 5:22 PM EDT By Steve Kopack The Trump administration ramped up a pressure campaign Thursday to persuade European allies to release diesel from national emergency stockpiles. The White House says additional diesel from Europe would increase global supplies and potentially keep a lid on soaring prices. The average U.S. price of diesel has soared by 70% since the war with Iran began, hitting $6.38 per gallon Thursday, according to AAA. Less than five weeks before the U.S. midterm elections, Republicans are eager for any way to lower domestic fuel prices. “Our European partners should accelerate delivery on their existing commitments and make additional supplies immediately available to address ongoing disruptions” to energy markets, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Thursday on X . “American farmers, truckers, and businesses should not be left carrying the burden of a global diesel shortage.” Shortly after Bessent’s post, Trump told reporters “we may” request that Europe release some of its emergency reserves. Earlier this week, U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright had appeared confident that Europe would agree to tap its reserves. “You will hear announcements from our friends in Europe about new diesel supplies that’ll come to the market that’ll meaningfully push diesel prices down,” Wright told reporters Wednesday at an event with Trump in the Oval Office. items.t: ChatGPT can now virtually try on clothes for you
items.d: OpenAI is rolling out new shopping features for ChatGPT that let users virtually try on clothing and accessories using their own photos and save products they like to a Favorites library.
items.fullText: OpenAI is again experimenting with how its conversational AI assistant, ChatGPT, can help users as they shop online. On Thursday, the company announced the global launch of two new shopping features, including a way to virtually try on clothing and accessories and a new favoriting function that can help users save products they like for later reference. The updates arrive at a time when AI assistants are exploring consumer use cases around shopping. OpenAI already had to pivot from one of its earlier ideas in this space, an instant checkout feature that ended up not performing well. More recently, agentic AI startup Instinct began pushing product recommendations to users, but some felt that the proactive recommendations were an overreach, more akin to ads than helpful suggestions. OpenAI said its new shopping features leverage the newly launched ChatGPT Images 2.5 model , which the company claims produces more natural lighting and richer textures, follows editing instructions more reliably, and reduces image generation latency. To start, virtual try-on allows ChatGPT users to upload a selfie or a full-body photo in order to visualize how an article of clothing or an accessory might look on them. This option will appear as a new Try On button in ChatGPT’s shopping results. You can also upload an image of an item, like a web screenshot, and ask ChatGPT to try it on for you. The other new option, Favorites, lets you save products you discover to a Library in the app so you can come back to them later. (These items will be saved alongside your try-on images, the company notes.) Image Credits: OpenAI OpenAI said that ChatGPT can help users shop in other ways, too. For instance, you could describe a style that you’d like to try, then ask it to shop for the pieces needed to complete the look. items.t: World’s first enhanced geothermal power plant completed in just 23 months
items.d: Fervo Energy completed its first power plant in less than two years. The next phases promise to connect to the grid even quicker.
items.fullText: Geothermal company Fervo Energy announced Thursday morning that it had started selling electricity from its Cape Station power plant to the grid on September 30, one day ahead of schedule. With it, Fervo becomes the first enhanced geothermal company to reach a key commercial milestone. The power plant synchronized with the grid about a week ago, bringing online the first third of what will soon become a 100-megawatt power plant. The entire site could be much larger, though, with the potential to generate as much as 4 gigawatts of electricity, Fervo previously told TechCrunch . “No team has ever built a project like this anywhere in the world, and we did it ahead of schedule,” Fervo co-founder and CEO Tim Latimer said in a statement. From groundbreaking to commercial operations, the first block at Cape Station took 23 months to complete. As Fervo refines its process, it is aiming to complete future blocks in as little as 18 months. That sort of speed to power should appeal to power-starved data center operators, who have been scouring every part of the energy sector for generating capacity. Geothermal can also be developed in phases, similar to how data centers are developed, allowing hyperscalers to bring racks online as demand ramps up. Google, Southern California Edison, and others have committed to buying power from Fervo’s Cape Station project. Fervo is one of several companies developing enhanced geothermal power plants. While traditional geothermal power taps heat sources close to the surface, Fervo and its peers are drilling deeper because deeper rock is hotter, opening more opportunities for development. Fervo went public in May in an upsized IPO that raised $1.9 billion. It was founded in 2017, bringing drilling techniques and technologies from the oil and gas sector to the development of new geothermal resources. As a startup, the company raised more than $1.3 billion from investors, including Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Congruent Ventures, and Capricorn

items.t: Photon held a funeral for mobile apps. Now it has $4.5M to help replace them with agents.
items.d: The startup helps developers build AI agents that work over iMessage, SMS/RCS, email, and other messaging platforms. It's a bet that consumers will increasingly use agents instead of downloading apps.
items.fullText: The AI startup Photon is so sure that agents will eventually come to replace mobile apps that it held a funeral for the latter — yes, a real funeral in a church, with speeches and everything. Photon, which helps developers build agents that work over iMessage and WhatsApp, now has $4.5 million in seed funding to develop its products. The raise comes after the company signed up over 40,000 developers and grew its revenue 10x in just four months, it says. Image Credits: Photon Photon co-founder and CEO Daniel Tian said the “ app funeral ,” held in San Francisco on September 17, was also a developer day for the startup, featuring panels from Vercel, Stripe, and OpenAI. It also included an actual coffin for app icons. The move to host an app funeral was obviously somewhat tongue-in-cheek, but Tian believes the app era is coming to an end. “Honestly, it’s going to take a while, but I think, directionally, it’s inevitable,” he said of the shift from apps to agents. Image Credits: Photon The thesis behind the startup, as you may have guessed, is that users no longer want to install new apps. Instead, they want access to agents that work through the messaging apps they already use, like iMessage and WhatsApp. Meta’s Muse, whose app has soared to No. 1 on the app stores, is putting that theory to the test. But even if Muse comes to dominate the consumer AI space, Tian sees a market for serving developers who want their applications to work over messaging services. That’s why Photon is offering a package of tools, including a unified API, an extensible channel framework, a command-line interface (CLI), and an observability suite. Combined, they allow developers to build and operate an agent experience that works over iMessage, WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS or RCS, email, voice, and more. The idea for Photon emerged from the time co-founders Tian and Ryan Zhu, the CTO, spent building consumer apps as students, often at hackathons

items.t: Hearing tech startup Legato launches its AI hearing glasses
items.d: The glasses stem from the startup’s goal of making hearing care more accessible by addressing the cost, comfort, and stigma associated with traditional hearing aids.
items.fullText: Hearing tech startup Legato announced on Thursday that its flagship AI-based hearing glasses are now available for purchase. The glasses, called Legato Frames , integrate the company’s patented hearing-assistance technology into the arms of eyewear frames. Starting at $999, Legato Frames are designed for adults with up to moderate levels of hearing loss. The glasses stem from the startup’s goal of making hearing care more accessible by addressing the cost, comfort, and stigma associated with traditional hearing aids. Unlike traditional hearing aids, which often use directional microphones to focus on sounds coming from a particular direction and can struggle in noisy environments, Legato takes a different approach. Its AI-powered system distinguishes voices from background noise and amplifies voices while reducing unwanted sounds. While the frames have an open-ear design, sound isn’t broadcast to people around you. The frames feature a dual-speaker system that directs sound toward the wearer while canceling sound that escapes, reducing sound by 99% just a few inches away from the ear. Image Credits: Legato All processing happens directly on the glasses, with no cameras or recording, the company says. The glasses weigh 34 grams with lenses and offer 10-12 hours of battery life. Legato Frames are available in three styles and support prescription lenses and Bluetooth streaming for music and calls. The official launch of the glasses comes a few weeks after the startup emerged from stealth with $12 million in funding from Neotribe Ventures, Listen, and Village Global. Legato was founded in 2024 by Mehul Trivedi and Steve Romine, who bring deep experience in wearables and hearing care from Bose, where Trivedi led the creation of Bose Frames and Romine ran the hearing aids division. After their time at Bose, Trivedi joined EssilorLuxottica, where he led smart eyewear efforts and worked on the Meta Ray-Ban smart glasses, while Romine went on to serve as COO of hearing care

Senate Democrats block Husted-led bill on data centers, calling it ‘toothless’
items.d: The bill aims to prevent data centers from spiking local utility costs. Republicans accused Democrats of playing political games, noting the bill passed the House 417-3.
items.fullText: Artificial intelligence Senate Democrats block Husted-led bill on data centers, calling it ‘toothless’ The bill aims to prevent data centers from spiking local utility costs. Republicans accused Democrats of playing political games, noting the bill passed the House 417-3. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Sen. Jon Husted, R-Ohio. Kevin Dietsch / Getty Images file Share Add NBC News to Google Sept. 30, 2026, 1:41 PM EDT By Sahil Kapur WASHINGTON — Senate Democrats blocked legislation Wednesday aimed at protecting consumers from paying higher prices when new data centers are built in their communities. The vote was 57-43, short of the 60 needed to break a filibuster. The Ratepayer Protection Act , which passed the House by a vote of 417-3 two weeks ago, would set a federal standard on the issue. It would also instruct state public utility commissions to find ways to make developers of data centers that use huge amounts of energy cover their own costs of water and electricity to consumers. The Senate version is led by appointed Sen. Jon Husted, R-Ohio, who’s locked in a competitive battle as he seeks his first full Senate term. He is facing heat at home from Democratic rival Sherrod Brown, a former senator who has branded him “the face of data centers” for promoting developments when he was lieutenant governor. “I heard they said they wanted lower electricity prices,” Husted said of Democrats on Tuesday. “All they have to do is not block it, vote for it, and it will be on the president’s desk, and we will have a bipartisan win.” Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer, D-N.Y., said the bill would be merely “optional” for states and wouldn’t achieve much beyond partisan messaging for Republicans. “Plain and simple, the Ratepayer Protection Act is a fraud,” Schumer told reporters Tuesday. “It does not require any protections at all. While Americans are demanding real guardrails on AI and data centers, Republicans are offering a toothless messaging bill.

items.fullText: 판타지의 경계를 확장하다: 삼성 스페이셜 사이니지가 도쿄게임쇼 2026에서 펼치는 캐릭터 IP와 리테일의 미래 2026/09/23 AI 요약 새로운 뉴스룸 AI 기능을 살펴보세요! 닫기 --> AUDIO Play Download 공유 레이어 열기 인쇄하기 9월 17일부터 20일까지 일본 지바현 마쿠하리 멧세(Makuhari Messe)에서 열린 도쿄게임쇼 2026(Tokyo Game Show 2026, TGS). 글로벌 게임 기업 엔씨 부스는 게임 속 캐릭터를 눈앞에서 만나는 듯한 경험을 하려는 관람객들의 발길이 이어졌다. 그 중심에는 게임의 세계관을 화면 밖으로 확장한 삼성전자의 무안경 3D 디스플레이 ‘스페이셜 사이니지(Spatial Signage)’가 있었다. 이번 행사에서 엔씨가 선보인 ‘아스트라에 오라티오(Astrae Oratio)’는 마법이 일상에 스며든 판타지 세계를 배경으로 한 신전기 서브컬처 RPG다. 삼성 스페이셜 사이니지는 독자적인 ‘3D 플레이트(3D Plate)’ 기술을 적용해 별도의 3D 안경 없이도 콘텐츠에 생생한 입체감을 선사하며, 게임 속 캐릭터와 세계관을 오프라인 전시 공간으로 확장했다. 팬덤 경험 확장… 캐릭터와의 만남을 현실 공간으로 게임 퍼블리셔와 콘텐츠 IP(Intellectual Property, 지식재산권) 보유 기업에게 오프라인 공간은 디지털 콘텐츠를 현실로 가져오는 중요한 접점이다. 엔씨는 도쿄게임쇼에서 85형과 32형 스페이셜 사이니지를 부스 입구와 대기 공간 등에 배치해 관람객이 이동하는 과정에서도 게임 속 캐릭터와 세계관을 자연스럽게 경험하도록 했다. 부스 입구에는 85형 스페이셜 사이니지로 ‘아스트라에 오라티오’ 게임의 주요 배경인 ‘특구청’ 건물 내 엘리베이터를 재현했다. 대형 디스플레이를 통해 캐릭터를 실제 사람과 가까운 크기로 표현해, 마치 게임 속 등장인물들이 현실 세계에 인사를 건네는 듯한 장면을 연출했다. ▲ ‘아스트라에 오라티오’ 부스 입구에 설치한 85형 스페이셜 사이니지는 게임 속 다양한 캐릭터가 눈 앞으로 다가오는 듯한 연출로 관람객의 이목을 끌었다. 엔씨 아스트라에 오라티오 사업실 이용수 실장은 “관람객들이 부스에 들어서는 순간부터 실제 크기의 캐릭터와 마주하고 게임 세계에 몰입하길 바랐다”면서 “서브컬처 장르에서는 캐릭터의 생동감과 현실감이 특히 중요한데, 스페이셜 사이니지가 이런 특성을 관람객에게 효과적으로 전달할 수 있다고 판단했다”고 말했다. 현장을 찾은 관람객들은 스페이셜 사이니지가 구현한 캐릭터의 크기와 입체감에 주목했다. 콘텐츠 크리에이터 카와이 코코(Kawaii CoCo) 씨는 “캐릭터가 실제로 움직이며 상호작용하는 것처럼 생생하게 느껴졌다”며 “일반 디스플레이보다 훨씬 눈에 띄고 소셜미디어에서도 근사하게 보일 것 같아, 이 장면을 촬영해 제 구독자들에게 소개하고 싶다”고 말했다. ▲ 콘텐츠 크리에이터 카와이 코코 씨는 캐릭터의 움직임이 스페이셜 사이니지를 통해 생동감 있게 전달되어 아스트라에 오라티오 부스로 눈길이 갔다고 말했다. 스페이셜 사이니지는 52mm 1 의 얇은 두께에도 불구하고 마치 화면 뒤에 별도의 공간이 있는 듯한 깊이감을 구현한 것이 특징이다. 이러한 경험은 대중에게 게임과 캐릭터의 첫인상을 전달하는 데도 효과적으로 활용될 수 있다. 관람객 다니엘 아세로(Daniel Acero) 씨는 “처음 봤을 때 스크린 화면인 줄 전혀 몰랐고, 투명한 설치물이라고 생각했다”면서 “마치 화면 뒤에 실제 공간이 있는 것처럼 깊이감이 느껴져서 놀라웠고, 이러한 방식으로 게임 캐릭터를 소개하면 게임에 대한 관심을 높이고 캐릭터의 개성을 효과적으로 전달할 수 있을 것”이라고 말했다. 관람객 동선과 대기 공간에는 32형 스페이셜 사이니지가 설치돼 부스 전반으로 캐릭터 경험을 확장했다. 32형 제품은 49.4mm의 얇은 두께로 좁은 공간에도 유연하게 설치가 가능해, 게임 체험을 기다리는 관람객을 대상으로 캐릭터와 세계관에 대한 몰입도를 유지했다. 관람객 토마스 포르티에(Tomas items.fullText: At AI Day Singapore, NVIDIA and Partners Showcase AI Advancements Across Southeast Asia September 22, 2026 by NVIDIA Writers 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! NVIDIA AI Day Singapore , which takes place Sept. 22-23 at the Raffles City Convention Centre, is offering attendees opportunities to explore the hands-on training, expert-led sessions and advanced tools to accelerate their work in AI and high-performance computing. At the event, NVIDIA and its partners are showcasing breakthrough AI advancements across the Southeast Asia region at large. Read more about these announcements below. NVIDIA Accelerates Public Sector AI from Pilot to Production in Southeast Asia 🔗 AI is becoming a matter of national strategy, with governments looking to move from pilots to production and deliver impact at scale, while building trusted AI capabilities that reflect local languages, cultures, priorities and economic needs. NVIDIA is working to enable all nations to be AI nations — providing the technology, infrastructure, ecosystem and expertise needed to make this possible. To accelerate this transition across Southeast Asia, NVIDIA is helping nations move AI from experimentation to production-scale deployment through open models, developer tools and a broad partner ecosystem. Together, NVIDIA and its partners are focusing on four key areas: Enhancing government operations and service delivery. Developing accessible AI-powered citizen services, and empowering local businesses. Strengthening critical infrastructure and public safety. Supporting startups, developers and researchers to strengthen national AI capabilities and innovation in each country. Singapore’s HTX (Home Team Science and Technology Agency) is embarking on research using the NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super and Nemotron 3 Nano Omni models to advance AI for public safety. items.fullText: AI Security Is an Engineering Problem — How to Solve It at Every Layer of the Agent Stack Open research, controls across the agent stack and continuous testing help defenders build and operate more secure AI systems. September 21, 2026 by Saša Zdjelar 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! AI security is an engineering problem. That means defined security requirements, enforceable controls, named owners and evidence that protections work. As AI becomes more capable, the industry must accelerate security engineering, broaden access to defensive tools and share what works faster. Technology Changes, Security Fundamentals Endure The internet and cloud computing changed how software operates, while core security responsibilities endured: establish identity, control access, limit exposure and verify that protections work. AI agents introduce new capabilities — reasoning , using tools and adapting actions based on the data they encounter. Those capabilities require applying established principles to new operating conditions. This pace creates pressure. Organizations want the productivity benefits of AI while the practices to govern and secure these systems are still developing. Security Depends on the Full Agent Stack Applications depend on code, data, identities, services and infrastructure. Security depends on how those components work together — and AI agents extend that system . Models provide capabilities; harnesses organize context, tools and workflows; and runtime environments provide the infrastructure within which actions execute. Each part of that stack carries security responsibilities, and proper protection requires controls across each layer, as data, instructions and actions move through the system. Consider an agent updating a customer record. Say it encounters malicious instructions in an attached document and attempts to export customer data to an unauthorized destination.
